claim: Coverage of the zone's independent businesses
problem: Only 22 of the 37 eligible Milltown businesses I surfaced in my own category searches are already listed (~59%). Even after discarding the four shakiest finds (PFT&K Insurance, Kale & Clovers, Milltown Foreign & Domestic Auto, Petri & Daughter) the ratio is 22/33 (~67%), still below the 70% bar. Whole categories are missing: independent pharmacies (none of three listed), florists beyond Hanna's, half the hair salons, most insurance brokers.
fix: Add the businesses in coverage.missing and run the category sweeps the mapper skipped: pharmacy, florist, insurance broker, hair salon, fitness/yoga, gutter/exterior, electrical. The mapper's own primary source (NJTGO) lists Milltown Pharmacy and Quick Mart Pharmacy, which were read but never entered.

claim: Alicia S. Lax, MD (family practice), 32 Ford Ave #2, 732-777-1940
problem: Contradicted. Directory records describe Alicia S. Lax as an LCSW (clinical social worker) at Jewish Family and Vocational Service of Middlesex County, 32 Ford Ave Floor 2, with a different phone; the 732-777-1940 number is associated with an Edison address. The 'MD family practice' category and the phone/address pairing do not hold up.
fix: Remove, or re-file as a clinical-social-worker listing with a verified phone, and confirm she still practices at 32 Ford Ave.

claim: Family & Cosmetic Dentistry of Ryders Lane, 100 Ryders Ln
problem: Not found under that name at that address. The dental practice reported at 100 Ryders Ln is Garden State Family and Cosmetic Dentistry / Dr. Sujithr Rajagopalan (732-296-1010); the only support for the listed name is a bizstanding directory page (403 to direct fetch). The entry rests on a single stale directory, as the mapper's own note admits.
fix: Verify the current tenant at 100 Ryders Ln (or drop the entry); if it exists, use the practice's current name and phone.

problem: The cited website returns HTTP 404. The salon itself is confirmed (NJTGO directory, sponsor page), but the website field is dead.
fix: Clear the website field or replace it with a live page (booking profile or social profile) after checking.

claim: Duplicate funeral-home entries: Bronson & McNamara Memorial Home and Bronson & Guthlein Funeral Home, both 152 N Main St
problem: Two entries at one address with no evidence they are two businesses. bronsonandmcnamaramemorial.com confirms 152 North Main Street, Milltown; the second entry's address is explicitly an inference and its own site (bronsonandguthleinfuneralhome.com) blocks fetching (403), so the relationship is unresolved.
fix: Resolve by call/borough record and merge into one record under the current trading name.

claim: RE/MAX Country (40 S Main St) and Norman's Hallmark Shop (Ryders Crossing)
problem: Both are brand/franchise operations (RE/MAX franchise office; Hallmark-branded card shop) sitting inside a list whose rules exclude chains and franchises. The mapper flagged both but kept them.
fix: Apply the exclusion rule consistently: either drop both, or state an explicit 'locally owned franchise' exception and apply it to RE/MAX, Hallmark and the multi-location martial-arts academies (Satori, Empower) alike.

problem: The cited Jewelers of America member page now returns HTTP 404, so the entry's strongest source could not be re-opened; only the sponsor page and a Superpages listing could corroborate.
fix: Re-cite a live source (Superpages listing or the store's own page) before using this entry.
